question.text: Paragraph: Two plane harmonic sound waves are expressed by the equations. $$ \begin{aligned} & y_1(x, t)=A \cos (0.5 \pi x-100 \pi t) \\ & y_2(x, t)=A \cos (0.46 \pi x-92 \pi t) \end{aligned} $$ (All parameters are in MKS)Question: How many times does an observer hear maximum intensity in one second?

solution.text:
In one second number of maximas is called the beat frequency. Hence,
$$
f_b=f_1-f_2=\frac{100 \pi}{2 \pi}-\frac{92 \pi}{2 \pi}=4 \mathrm{~Hz}
$$
